business_profile.business_overview: Notun Thikana Properties Ltd. is a fast-growing real estate portal in Bangladesh that connects buyers, sellers, and renters across Dhaka (Bashundhara, Dhanmondi, Gulshan, and beyond). They list residential and commercial properties for sale and rent, with listing prices ranging from BDT 50,000/month rentals up to BDT 70M+ sales. They maintain an active multi-channel presence — Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and a WhatsApp line (+8801896280607) — and produce video property tours. As a portal, their revenue depends on matching serious buyers/renters to listings fast, which makes lead response speed and buyer follow-up the single biggest driver of their success.

business_profile.competitive_position: Notun Thikana competes with established portals (Bproperty, Bikroy, Lamudi) that have larger listing volumes and, in some cases, better lead tooling. Their edge is a curated, active, video-rich presence and personal service. But in a market where buyers message 3-4 portals at once, the one that responds in seconds and books the viewing wins. Without an AI agent answering every WhatsApp/social enquiry instantly and qualifying buyers, Notun Thikana loses the speed race on exactly the high-value listings where commission is biggest.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With listings up to BDT 70M and typical portal commissions of 1-2%, a single closed sale is worth BDT 70K-1.4M in commission. If slow/manual enquiry handling loses even 2-3 serious buyers per month to faster portals, that's BDT 2-4M+ in lost commission annually. An AI agent that answers every enquiry instantly, qualifies budget/location/timeline, and books viewings would directly recover this — and nurture the long tail of buyers who aren't ready today.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI buyer-response agent on WhatsApp + all social channels that replies to every enquiry in seconds, qualifies budget, preferred area, and timeline, and matches them to live listings.
2. Viewing scheduler that offers available slots and books property viewings automatically, sending reminders to cut no-shows.
3. Buyer follow-up agent that nurtures enquirers who don't book immediately — sends new matching listings, price-drop alerts, and video tours over time.
4. Seller intake agent that captures new listing requests with photos, location, and price, feeding the portal pipeline without manual data entry.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A buyer watches Notun Thikana's YouTube tour of a 2850 SFT furnished Dhanmondi apartment (BDT 150K/month) and messages the WhatsApp line at 10pm: 'Is this still available?' In 8 seconds the AI replies: 'Yes! 2850 SFT, 3 bed, furnished, ৳150,000/month in Dhanmondi. Would you like a viewing? I have Saturday 11am or Sunday 3pm.' The buyer picks Saturday. The agent books it, sends a calendar invite + location pin, and logs a structured brief (budget, move-in timeline, family size) for the agent handling the viewing. Zero human effort, and the buyer never had a chance to message a competing portal.
